description: Elections Customs - Declare that a member of the Panvila Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and matters related to local authority elections, specifically covered by Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for electoral commission decisions and declarations regarding elected officials.
